 Job Description – ServiceNow Technical Consultant (Salesforce ITSM Migration)

 Position Summary

 We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Technical Consultant to support multiple strategic ITSM transformation initiative involving the migration of ServiceNow data, configurations, workflows, integrations, and operational processes to the Salesforce ITSM platform . The consultant will serve as the primary ServiceNow Subject Matter Expert (SME) within the migration program, collaborating closely with migration teams, Salesforce consultants, business stakeholders and client representatives.

The role requires a strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, workflows, and ITSM processes, along with the ability to analyze, map, and transform ServiceNow components into Salesforce ITSM equivalents. The consultant will actively participate in client workshops, migration planning sessions and technical design discussions to ensure a successful transition.

 Key Responsibilities

 ServiceNow Analysis & Assessment

 • Act as the ServiceNow technical SME for migration and transformation activities. 
• Analyze existing ServiceNow implementations, including: 
• Incident Management 
• Request Management 
• Change Management 
• Problem Management 
• Knowledge Management 
• Service Catalog 
• CMDB 
• Custom Applications 
• Assess ServiceNow configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, and data structures for migration readiness. 
• Document current-state architecture, business processes, data dependencies, and technical configurations. 

 Migration & Transformation Support

 • Support migration teams in extracting and validating ServiceNow data and configurations. 
• Define migration strategies for: 
• Data objects 
• Configuration items 
• Service Catalog items 
• Workflows and business rules 
• Approval processes 
• Notifications 
• Reports and dashboards 
• Identify data transformation requirements and potential migration risks. 
• Assist in reconciliation, validation, and post-migration verification activities. 

 Salesforce ITSM Collaboration

 • Partner with Salesforce ITSM architects, consultants, and developers to map ServiceNow functionality to Salesforce capabilities. 
• Define field mappings, object mappings, data relationships, and workflow transformations. 
• Translate ServiceNow business processes into Salesforce ITSM workflows and automation frameworks. 
• Provide recommendations on process redesign, optimization, and platform alignment. 
• Support testing and validation of migrated configurations and workflows within Salesforce. 

 Client & Stakeholder Engagement

 • Participate in client workshops, discovery sessions, design reviews, and migration planning meetings. 
• Present ServiceNow technical assessments and migration recommendations to stakeholders. 
• Serve as the trusted advisor for all ServiceNow-related queries and decisions. 
• Collaborate with business users, technical teams, and project leadership throughout the migration lifecycle. 

 Documentation & Governance

 • Create and maintain detailed migration documentation. 
• Document field mapping matrices, transformation rules, workflow mappings, and technical specifications. 
• Support audit, governance, compliance, and change management requirements. 
• Contribute to migration runbooks, playbooks, and knowledge transfer activities. 

 Required Qualifications

 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. 
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow platform administration, development, or consulting. 
• Strong understanding of ServiceNow ITSM modules and platform architecture. 
• Experience working with: 
• ServiceNow Workflows / Flow Designer 
• Business Rules 
• Script Includes 
• Service Catalog 
• CMDB 
• Integrations and APIs 
• Reporting and Dashboards 
• Proven experience in platform migrations, upgrades, or transformation programs. 
• Strong knowledge of data migration principles and ETL concepts. 
• Excellent documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. 
• Ability to participate in client-facing discussions and technical workshops. 

 Preferred Qualifications

 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA). 
• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – ITSM. 
• Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or Salesforce ITSM implementations. 
• Familiarity with integration technologies and middleware platforms. 
• Experience in ITIL-based service management environments. 
• Knowledge of data mapping, transformation, and migration tools. 
• Prior experience in ServiceNow-to-Salesforce transformation initiatives is highly desirable. 

 Key Skills

 ServiceNow

 • ServiceNow ITSM 
• Flow Designer 
• Workflow Engine 
• CMDB 
• Service Catalog 
• Business Rules 
• Script Includes 
• Client Scripts 
• REST/SOAP APIs 

 Salesforce Collaboration

 • Salesforce Service Cloud / ITSM 
• Data Mapping 
• Process Transformation 
• Workflow Translation 
• Configuration Assessment 

 Professional Skills

 • Client Engagement 
• Technical Consulting 
• Stakeholder Management 
• Requirements Analysis 
• Documentation 
• Problem Solving 
• Communication & Presentation Skills 

 Success Criteria

 The Successful Candidate Will

 • Provide expert ServiceNow guidance throughout the migration lifecycle. 
• Enable accurate migration of ServiceNow data, configurations, workflows, and processes to Salesforce ITSM. 
• Drive effective collaboration between ServiceNow and Salesforce teams. 
• Ensure business process continuity and minimize migration risks. 
• Serve as the primary ServiceNow technical advisor in client-facing engagements. 

 Location: Bangalore, India (On-site/Hybrid as required)

 Employment Type: Full-Time

 Experience: 5–10+ Years Preferred

 Position Summary 

 Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant 

 Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.

 Work you will do 

 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant , you would be expected to perform the following activities:

 • Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations. 
• Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service. 
• Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns. 
• Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen. 
• Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration. 
• Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions. 
• Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations. 
• Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities. 

 Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)

 • Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking. 
• Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions. 
• Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling. 
• Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities. 
• Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. 
• Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation. 
• Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload. 
• Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management. 
• Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response. 
• Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements. 

 Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)

 Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.

 Required Qualifications

 • 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform). 
• Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response. 
• Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes. 
• Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing. 
• Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer). 
• Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders. 

 Preferred / Nice To Have

 • ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications. 
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms. 
• Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion. 

 Core Skills

 ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.

 Education: 

 • Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

 Location: 

 • Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai 

 Our purpose

 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. Role Description

 Job Title– (Lead Servicenow Developer, ITOM,CMDB)

Hiring Location : Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Noida, Kochi, Hyderabad, Trivandrum

Senior ServiceNow Developer Focus: CMDB, CSDM and Integrations Role Summary The candidate should have a strong background in ServiceNow development and customization, with extensive experience designing, implementing, and governing Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) capabilities, together with a proven track record building robust platform and data integrations.

The role requires deep knowledge of CMDB architecture, CSDM data modelling, the Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), enterprise integration patterns (REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, Service Graph Connectors), and data governance.  Position Summary 

 Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant 

 Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.

 Work you will do 

 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant , you would be expected to perform the following activities:

 • Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations. 
• Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service. 
• Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns. 
• Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen. 
• Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration. 
• Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions. 
• Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations. 
• Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities. 

 Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)

 • Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking. 
• Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions. 
• Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling. 
• Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities. 
• Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. 
• Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation. 
• Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload. 
• Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management. 
• Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response. 
• Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements. 

 Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)

 Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.

 Required Qualifications

 • 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform). 
• Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response. 
• Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes. 
• Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing. 
• Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer). 
• Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders. 

 Preferred / Nice To Have

 • ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications. 
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms. 
• Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion. 

 Core Skills

 ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.

 Education: 

 • Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

 Location: 

 • Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Delhi/Mumbai

 Essential Experience & Skills

• Ability to coordinate and support testing activities, including defining test scenarios, coordinating UAT, and managing sign-off processes.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills — able to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile delivery environment with multiple concurrent workstreams.
• Demonstrable experience working on ServiceNow HRSD implementations or enhancements, with hands-on familiarity with HRSD modules including Case Management, Lifecycle Events, or Employee Centre Pro.

 Work you will do 

 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant , you would be expected to perform the following activities:

 • Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.

• Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions. 
• Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations. 
• Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities. 

 Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)

 • Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking. 
• Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions. 
• Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling. 
• Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities. 
• Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. 
• Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation. 
• Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload. 
• Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management. 
• Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response. 
• Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

• Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders. 

 Preferred / Nice To Have

• Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

 Position Summary 

 Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant 

 Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.

We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.

 Work you will do 

 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant , you would be expected to perform the following activities:

 • Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations. 
• Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service. 
• Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns. 
• Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen. 
• Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration. 
• Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions. 
• Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations. 
• Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities. 

 Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)

 • Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking. 
• Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions. 
• Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling. 
• Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities. 
• Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. 
• Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation. 
• Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload. 
• Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management. 
• Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response. 
• Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements. 

 Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)

 Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.

 Required Qualifications

 • 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform). 
• Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response. 
• Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes. 
• Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing. 
• Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer). 
• Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders. 

 Preferred / Nice To Have

 • ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications. 
• Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms. 
• Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion. 

 Core Skills

 ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.

 Education: 

 • Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

 Position Overview

 Oversees, facilitates and administers ITIL based service support. Manages and oversees Unisys service delivery through processes, including incident, major incident, problem, request and change management with a focus on improving overall service quality. Coordinates client-facing resources and potentially client and client partners to facilitate compliance with service quality commitments.

 Key Responsibilities

 Major Incident Management (MIM)

 • Provide operational support for Major Incident Management activities across assigned accounts.
• Coordinate Major Incident bridge calls and engage technical resolver teams to expedite service restoration.
• Gather, validate, and document incident details, business impact, affected services, and timelines.
• Ensure timely stakeholder communications during incident lifecycle including identification, escalation, recovery, and closure.
• Track incident progress, action items, and ownership to maintain momentum toward resolution.
• Assist in conducting post-incident reviews and documenting root cause analysis (RCA).
• Ensure MIM documentation, communication templates, and knowledge repositories are maintained and updated.
• Monitor compliance with MIM process requirements and escalation procedures.
• Identify recurring incident trends and collaborate with Problem Management for long-term remediation. 

 Change Management (CM)

 • Review Change Requests for completeness, quality, risk assessment, implementation plans, and rollback readiness.
• Monitor change schedules and facilitate conflict detection, impact analysis, and risk mitigation activities.
• Coordinate and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
• Ensure compliance with Change Management policies, procedures, and governance controls.
• Perform post-implementation reviews (PIRs) and track remediation actions for failed or backed-out changes.
• Monitor emergency and unauthorized changes and escalate process violations as appropriate.
• Maintain change calendars and support planning activities across multiple stakeholders.
• Produce change-related dashboards, compliance reports, and governance metrics.
• Drive continual improvement initiatives aimed at reducing change-related incidents and service disruptions. 
• Problem Management (PM)
• Facilitate identification, logging, categorization, prioritization, and tracking of problem records.
• Coordinate Problem Review Board (PRB) meetings and follow-up activities.
• Ensure root cause analysis is conducted and documented for high-impact incidents and recurring issues.
• Track corrective and preventive actions through closure.
• Monitor known errors and workaround documentation for operational teams.
• Analyze incident trends and identify potential problem candidates.
• Collaborate with technical teams to drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
• Measure and report effectiveness of problem management activities and preventive actions.
• Support continual service improvement by identifying opportunities to reduce incident recurrence. 
• Governance, Reporting & Process Compliance
• Generate and distribute service management reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI metrics.
• Monitor process compliance across MIM, Change, and Problem Management functions.
• Conduct regular audits of service management records and process adherence.
• Participate in governance reviews, operational meetings, and client service reviews.
• Support internal and external audit requirements through evidence gathering and documentation.
• Maintain process documentation, SOPs, work instructions, and knowledge articles.
• Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance operational effectiveness.
• Ensure contractual obligations, service levels, and operational targets are met. 
• Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Maintain effective working relationships with clients, service delivery teams, resolver groups, and leadership.
• Provide clear, concise, and timely written and verbal communications.
• Facilitate operational meetings including Daily Operations Reviews, CAB, PRB, and MIM Reviews.
• Escalate service risks, compliance concerns, and operational issues to management as required.
• Provide training, coaching, and process guidance to support teams and stakeholders.

• Major Incident Coordination & Communication
• Change Advisory Board (CAB) Facilitation
• Problem Review Board (PRB) Facilitation
• Root Cause Analysis Tracking
• Post Incident Reviews (PIR)
• Governance Reporting & Dashboards
• Service Management Compliance Audits
• KPI / SLA / XLA Reporting
• Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement Initiatives

Job Summary

 Serve as a senior functional analyst within the integrated solutions group translating complex business needs into scalable ServiceNow implementations across IT service operations customer workflows and business management. Apply deep platform expertise and scripting knowledge to deliver stable hybrid model solutions that streamline operations for enterprise clients in the telecom and adjacent sectors.

 Responsibilities

 • Collaborate with business stakeholders to analyze service operation needs and translate them into robust ServiceNow configurations that increase process efficiency and reliability across the enterprise environment.
• Design and optimize ServiceNow ITSM processes such as incident problem change and request management to ensure consistent service quality and measurable improvements in resolution times.
• Configure and enhance ServiceNow CSM capabilities to support customer facing workflows that improve case handling service level adherence and customer satisfaction for large scale clients.
• Implement and maintain ServiceNow TSOM capabilities to monitor service health correlate events and proactively identify issues that could affect critical business services.
• Develop ServiceNow ITOM solutions with a focus on discovery service mapping and event management to provide accurate visibility of infrastructure and application dependencies.
• Utilize JavaScript ES5 and ES6 along with ServiceNow scripting APIs to create client scripts business rules and server side logic that enforce business policies and improve user experience.
• Configure ServiceNow Business Management modules to support demand project and portfolio management so that business leaders can prioritize investments based on value and risk.
• Implement ServiceNow TSM workflows that streamline case handling for internal teams and partner organizations ensuring standardized processes and traceable audit trails.
• Develop and maintain ServiceNow Orchestration workflows to automate routine operational tasks and integrations reducing manual effort and minimizing operational risk.
• Collaborate with technical teams to define data models interface requirements and integration patterns that ensure accurate information flow between ServiceNow and external enterprise systems.
• Prepare functional specifications configuration documentation and user guides that clearly describe implemented solutions and support efficient knowledge transfer to operations teams.
• Partner with testing teams to define test scenarios validate end to end workflows and ensure that delivered capabilities meet both functional expectations and performance standards.
• Support production deployments and post go live stabilization by analyzing issues proposing corrective actions and optimizing configurations based on real usage insights.
• Coordinate with process owners to capture reporting needs and configure ServiceNow dashboards and analytics that provide actionable insights into service performance and operational trends.
• Mentor junior analysts by reviewing their configurations and documentation sharing platform best practices and promoting adherence to standardized methods and naming conventions.
• Collaborate across geographically distributed teams using hybrid work practices ensuring timely communication transparent progress updates and consistent alignment with project objectives.
• Align platform enhancements with organizational goals so that every change contributes directly to improved service reliability reduced operational cost or better customer experience.

 Qualifications

 • Demonstrate proven hands on experience across ServiceNow ITSM CSM TSOM and ITOM modules with a strong track record of configuring end to end workflows for complex enterprise environments.
• Exhibit solid proficiency in ServiceNow scripting using JavaScript ES5 and ES6 to build scalable client scripts business rules and custom logic that comply with platform standards.
• Show practical experience with ServiceNow Orchestration and TSM to automate operational tasks and extend service workflows beyond core IT services where appropriate.
• Apply working knowledge of ServiceNow Business Management to describe business demands track project progress and support portfolio level decision making for stakeholders.
• Leverage exposure to telecom industry processes or similar large scale service environments to design solutions that address network operations service assurance or customer care needs.
• Communicate clearly with both technical and non technical partners in a hybrid work setting while managing expectations gathering requirements and explaining solution options.
• Bring six to eight years of relevant professional experience as a functional analyst or consultant with a focus on ServiceNow platform solutions in multinational or similarly complex organizations.

 Certifications Required

 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and at least one advanced certification such as ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist ITSM or ITOM

What Success Looks Like In This Role

 Job Title: MIM, Change & Problem Management - Engineer Service Management

 Location : Bangalore

 Who We Are

 Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit www.unisys.com.

 Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.

 Our Core Beliefs

 • Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
• Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
• Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
• Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

 Position Overview

 Oversees, facilitates and administers ITIL based service support. Manages and oversees Unisys service delivery through processes, including incident, major incident, problem, request and change management with a focus on improving overall service quality. Coordinates client-facing resources and potentially client and client partners to facilitate compliance with service quality commitments.

 Key Responsibilities

 Major Incident Management (MIM)

 • Provide operational support for Major Incident Management activities across assigned accounts.
• Coordinate Major Incident bridge calls and engage technical resolver teams to expedite service restoration.
• Gather, validate, and document incident details, business impact, affected services, and timelines.
• Ensure timely stakeholder communications during incident lifecycle including identification, escalation, recovery, and closure.
• Track incident progress, action items, and ownership to maintain momentum toward resolution.
• Assist in conducting post-incident reviews and documenting root cause analysis (RCA).
• Ensure MIM documentation, communication templates, and knowledge repositories are maintained and updated.
• Monitor compliance with MIM process requirements and escalation procedures.
• Identify recurring incident trends and collaborate with Problem Management for long-term remediation. 

 Change Management (CM)

 • Review Change Requests for completeness, quality, risk assessment, implementation plans, and rollback readiness.
• Monitor change schedules and facilitate conflict detection, impact analysis, and risk mitigation activities.
• Coordinate and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings.
• Ensure compliance with Change Management policies, procedures, and governance controls.
• Perform post-implementation reviews (PIRs) and track remediation actions for failed or backed-out changes.
• Monitor emergency and unauthorized changes and escalate process violations as appropriate.
• Maintain change calendars and support planning activities across multiple stakeholders.
• Produce change-related dashboards, compliance reports, and governance metrics.
• Drive continual improvement initiatives aimed at reducing change-related incidents and service disruptions. 
• Problem Management (PM)
• Facilitate identification, logging, categorization, prioritization, and tracking of problem records.
• Coordinate Problem Review Board (PRB) meetings and follow-up activities.
• Ensure root cause analysis is conducted and documented for high-impact incidents and recurring issues.
• Track corrective and preventive actions through closure.
• Monitor known errors and workaround documentation for operational teams.
• Analyze incident trends and identify potential problem candidates.
• Collaborate with technical teams to drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
• Measure and report effectiveness of problem management activities and preventive actions.
• Support continual service improvement by identifying opportunities to reduce incident recurrence. 
• Governance, Reporting & Process Compliance
• Generate and distribute service management reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI metrics.
• Monitor process compliance across MIM, Change, and Problem Management functions.
• Conduct regular audits of service management records and process adherence.
• Participate in governance reviews, operational meetings, and client service reviews.
• Support internal and external audit requirements through evidence gathering and documentation.
• Maintain process documentation, SOPs, work instructions, and knowledge articles.
• Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance operational effectiveness.
• Ensure contractual obligations, service levels, and operational targets are met. 
• Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Maintain effective working relationships with clients, service delivery teams, resolver groups, and leadership.
• Provide clear, concise, and timely written and verbal communications.
• Facilitate operational meetings including Daily Operations Reviews, CAB, PRB, and MIM Reviews.
• Escalate service risks, compliance concerns, and operational issues to management as required.
• Provide training, coaching, and process guidance to support teams and stakeholders. 
• Key Deliverables
• Major Incident Coordination & Communication
• Change Advisory Board (CAB) Facilitation
• Problem Review Board (PRB) Facilitation
• Root Cause Analysis Tracking
• Post Incident Reviews (PIR)
• Governance Reporting & Dashboards
• Service Management Compliance Audits
• KPI / SLA / XLA Reporting
• Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement Initiatives 
• Required Skills
• ITIL Foundation Certification (preferred)
• Strong understanding of Incident, Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes
• ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platform experience
• Strong analytical and reporting skills
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Experience facilitating governance and operational meetings
• Knowledge of KPI, SLA, OLA, and service management reporting
• Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and Microsoft 365 skills 

 You will be successful in this role if you have:

 Any degree and 2-4 years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience

 We are seeking a highly experienced ServiceNow ITOM and ITAM Architect to design, implement, and optimize ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) and IT Asset Management (ITAM) solutions. This role will be responsible for architecting scalable ITOM solutions, integrating with CMDB, and ensuring alignment with ITSM, ITAM, and security operations. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CSDM and AIOps, as well as experience working in complex enterprise environments
  
• Key Responsibilities: 
  
• ITOM Solution Architecture & Implementation 
 • Lead the design and implementation of ServiceNow ITOM solutions, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, Orchestration, and AIOps.
 • Define technical architecture and solution blueprints for ITOM implementations, ensuring scalability and efficiency.
 • Develop strategies to automate IT operations using ServiceNow workflows, integrations, and AI/ML capabilities.

  
• ITAM Solution Architecture & Implementation 
 • Lead the design and implementation of ServiceNow ITAM solutions, covering Hardware Asset Management (HAM Pro), Software Asset Management (SAM Pro), and Cloud Insights.
 • Define the asset data model and its alignment with CMDB and CSDM, including asset-to-CI reconciliation, normalization, and lifecycle states.
 • Architect software licence management: entitlement ingestion, publisher packs, licence metrics, reclamation workflows, and true-up readiness for publishers such as Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, SAP, and VMware.
 • Design hardware asset lifecycle processes across procurement, receiving, stockroom, deployment, refresh, and disposal, integrated with Procurement and Finance systems.
 • Establish ITAM governance, KPIs, and dashboards covering licence compliance, asset accuracy, cost optimisation, and audit readiness.

  
  
• CMDB & Service Mapping 
 • Architect CMDB strategies to ensure accurate data ingestion, normalization, reconciliation, and governance.
 • Implement Service Mapping to discover and visualize business services and application dependencies.
 • Define CI class structures, reconciliation rules, and CMDB compliance policies.

  
• Event Management & Monitoring 
 • Design and implement ServiceNow Event Management to correlate events from monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, SolarWinds, Dynatrace).
 • Optimize Operational Intelligence (AIOps) capabilities to enhance predictive and automated issue resolution.
 • Develop alert and incident correlation strategies to reduce noise and improve ITOM efficiency.

  
• Governance, Compliance & Best Practices 
 • Define ITOM governance frameworks to ensure data accuracy, security, and compliance with IT policies.
 • Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure ITOM performance, CMDB health, and event management efficiency.
 • Conduct ITOM maturity assessments and recommend strategies for continuous improvement.

  
• Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration 
 • Collaborate with ITSM, ITAM, SecOps, DevOps, and Cloud teams to ensure seamless ITOM integration.
 • Engage with senior leadership, business owners, and technical teams to drive ITOM adoption.
 • Provide technical mentorship to ServiceNow administrators and developers.

  
•  Optimization & Best Practices: 
 • Continually optimize the discovery process to reduce false positives/negatives and improve discovery accuracy.

 • Develop and document best practices for cloud discovery, including tuning configurations, optimizing performance, and securing cloud data.
 • Monitor and manage the health and performance of cloud discovery jobs to ensure optimal performance and data accuracy.
 • Conduct regular audits of cloud resources and align them with enterprise governance and compliance requirements.

     
•  Training & Documentation: 
 • Provide guidance and training to technical staff on cloud discovery architecture, processes, and troubleshooting.

 • Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, discovery runbooks, and operational support guides.

  
• Now Assist in ITOM & ITAM 
 • Define the Now Assist adoption roadmap for ITOM and ITAM, identifying high-value AI use cases and sequencing enablement across environments.
 • Implement Now Assist for ITOM capabilities, including AI-generated incident and alert summarisation, alert grouping insights, and guided remediation recommendations.
 • Enable Now Assist for ITAM use cases such as contract and entitlement summarisation, asset request assistance, and AI-supported licence optimisation insights.
 • Configure and govern the underlying AI platform components - Now Assist skills, skill kits, AI Search, and generative AI controllers - with appropriate role-based access.
 • Establish responsible-AI governance for Now Assist: data privacy, prompt and response quality review, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and measurement of deflection and productivity benefits.

   
• Required Skills & Qualifications: 
 • Technical Expertise: • 7+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITOM (Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, Orchestration, AIOps).
 • Deep knowledge of CMDB architecture, CSDM 4.0, and Service Graph Connectors.
 • Experience integrating ServiceNow with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, SolarWinds).
 • Strong understanding of ITIL 4, ITSM, SIAM, and ITOM best practices.
 • Proficiency in JavaScript, REST API, PowerShell, and automation frameworks.
 • Experience with ServiceNow MID Server architecture and secure credential management.
 

 • Soft Skills: • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex ITOM issues.
 • Ability to lead technical teams and mentor junior architects.
 

 • Certifications (Preferred): • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITOM
 • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
 • ServiceNow Certified CMDB/CSDM Specialist
 • ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
 • AWS, Azure, or GCP certification (for cloud automation expertise

job_title: SOC Lead - Cyber Security Operations - VOIS
job_description:
Who We Are

 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

 About This Role

 We are seeking an experienced SOC Lead to head Vodafone’s Security Operations Centre (SOC) as part of Cyber Defence Operations (CDO). This role is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of SOC monitoring and response services across markets, ensuring consistent, high-quality detection and incident response in a 24x7 environment.

The role combines operational leadership, deep technical expertise, and a strong transformation mindset, with a particular focus on embedding automation and AI-driven capabilities into live SOC operations. Acting as a bridge between operational excellence and SOC modernisation, the individual will ensure that new capabilities are effectively adopted, governed, and optimised to strengthen Vodafone’s global cyber defence posture.

 What You’ll Do

 Lead and manage 24x7 SOC operations, ensuring consistent, high-quality alert monitoring, triage, and incident response across all markets.Own and drive SOC service performance against key KPIs including MTTT, MTTR, triage quality, and SLA adherence, delivering measurable improvements in detection quality, response speed, and efficiency.Oversee the full alert lifecycle, ensuring accurate investigation, containment, escalation, and high-quality incident reporting.Continuously enhance detection capabilities by improving SIEM use cases, alert logic, and playbooks, reducing false positives and increasing coverage across priority threat scenarios.Drive the adoption of automation, SOAR, and AI-assisted capabilities to improve speed, consistency, and scalability, with appropriate governance and human oversight.Lead SOC transformation initiatives focused on reducing alert fatigue, streamlining workflows, and improving analyst productivity.Build, coach, and develop a high-performing SOC team through structured capability development, performance management, and knowledge sharing.Act as the final escalation point for complex or high-risk incidents, applying expert judgement to validate and close cases.Deliver clear, data-driven SOC performance and incident reporting to senior leadership.Foster a culture of continuous improvement through post-incident reviews, detection retrospectives, and operational learning.

 Who You Are

 An experienced cybersecurity professional with 8+ years in security operations, including at least 4+ years in a SOC leadership or senior incident response role.A proven leader of 24x7 SOC teams, with a strong track record of improving MTTT/MTTR, triage quality, and operational performance.A technical authority in incident response, capable of leading complex investigations and making sound decisions under pressure.Highly experienced with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, ArcSight, or QRadar, and familiar with EDR/NDR technologies.Skilled in driving SOC automation, SOAR, and AI-enabled capabilities, with a clear understanding of governance and responsible use.Knowledgeable across network, endpoint, and cloud security, with a strong grasp of attacker techniques and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.An analytical decision-maker who balances risk, speed, and business impact in ambiguous situations.Passionate about developing people and building sustainable SOC capability for the future.Educated to degree level in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).Holder of relevant certifications such as GIAC, CISSP, or vendor-specific SOC certifications; interest or exposure to AI/ML in security is an advantage.Committed to continuous learning, innovation, and contribution to the wider security community.

 Not a perfect fit?

 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

 What's In It For You

 The opportunity to lead a globally impactful SOC function within a recognised Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence.Exposure to large-scale, complex cyber defence operations across multiple international markets.The chance to shape and influence the future of SOC operations through automation and AI-driven transformation.A collaborative, inclusive environment that supports professional growth and continuous learning.The ability to work with advanced security technologies and experienced cyber defence professionals.

 What Skills You Will Learn

 Advanced SOC leadership in a highly automated, AI-enabled operational environment.Strategic integration of SOAR and AI capabilities into live security operations.Enhanced stakeholder communication and executive-level cyber risk reporting.Scalable SOC governance and performance management across global operations.Deepened expertise in emerging threat landscapes and modern detection engineering.

 VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment

 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

 Join Us

 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.

#JDEnhancedByTARA

Job Summary

 As an Application Tech Support Practitioner aligned to the ITAM practice, you will be the data-quality and lifecycle steward for the client's Hardware Asset Management and Configuration Management Database estate on the Now Platform. Your typical day will involve executing Discovery and inventory reconciliation, maintaining asset and CI records, driving HAM workflow tickets (procurement → receive → deploy → maintain → retire → dispose), running CMDB Health remediation, and producing scheduled governance reports. You will work under moderate supervision and own an assigned CI class group or hardware category as the SME to L1 and L3 teams.

Key Responsibilities

HAM

Execute the end-to-end hardware asset lifecycle on ServiceNow HAM/HAM Pro-on Order, In Stock, In Use, In Maintenance, Retired, Disposed states-for end-user devices, data center equipment, network gear, and consumables.

Maintain alm_asset and alm_hardware records: asset tags, serial numbers, ownership, location, cost-centre, depreciation, and warranty/lease attributes.

Process and fulfil IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) tickets, hardware refresh/reclamation, transfer orders between stockrooms, and disposal orders with full audit-trail documentation.

Understand HAM / CMDB normalization concept-resolve unnormalized models, manufacturer aliases, and EOL/EOSL dates; drive normalization to ≥95% target.

Perform scheduled and ad-hoc inventory audits (including Mobile Agent/barcode scanning); reconcile physical vs. system records and remediate ghost/missing assets.

Track lease and warranty data, raise renewals 60-90 days in advance, and feed refresh planning into Procurement.

Maintain stockroom, bundle, consumable, and model-category data per defined policy.

CMDB

Maintain CI hygiene across CMDB CI classes within scope.

Apply and tune Identification & Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules-identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source precedence, and inclusion rules-for assigned CI classes; resolve duplicate-CI and overloaded-CI exceptions.

Drive and configure CMDB Health remediation against Completeness, Compliance, and Correctness KPIs in CMDB Workspace; clear orphan/stale/duplicate CI failures before the failure threshold is reached.

Configure and process CI attestation, Data Certification, and CMDB Workspace Data Manager retirement/delete policies for stale CIs.

Maintain CI relationships per the Common Service Data Model (CSDM 5.0)-Foundation, Ideation & Strategy, Design & Planning, Build & Integration, Service Delivery, Service Consumption, and Manage Portfolios domains.

Build and schedule operational reports and Performance Analytics widgets covering CMDB Health %, Hardware Normalization %, Asset Refresh due, Stockroom inventory, and Audit findings.

 Required Skills

 3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow/others administration with at least 2 years on HAM and/or CMDB.

Demonstrated working knowledge of HAM lifecycle states, asset/model/category data model, stockrooms, transfer orders, purchase orders, receiving slips, asset bundles, and disposal orders.

Working knowledge of CMDB tables, CI classes, and CSDM concepts.

Hands-on with IRE identification rules, reconciliation rules, and at least one duplicate-CI deduplication exercise.

Working knowledge of CMDB Health (Completeness, Compliance, Correctness) and dashboard remediation.

ITIL v4 process awareness-Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management, Service Request.

Import Sets/Transform Maps fundamentals; ability to read JavaScript/Glide script for basic edits.

Strong written and oral communication in English; ability to run client status calls.

Tools & Technologies

ServiceNow Modules

HAM, HAM Pro, ITAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM, Performance Analytics, Mobile Agent, CMDB Workspace, Hardware Asset Workspace, Now Assist for ITAM (awareness).

Educational Qualification:

15 years of full-time education

Flexible to work in any shift, including rotational shifts, based on business requirements

 As an Application Tech Support Practitioner aligned to the ITAM practice, you will be the data-quality and lifecycle steward for the client's Hardware Asset Management and Configuration Management Database estate on the Now Platform. Your typical day will involve executing Discovery and inventory reconciliation, maintaining asset and CI records, driving HAM workflow tickets (procurement → receive → deploy → maintain → retire → dispose), running CMDB Health remediation, and producing scheduled governance reports. You will work under moderate supervision and own an assigned CI class group or hardware category as the SME to L1 and L3 teams.

Key Responsibilities

HAM

Execute the end-to-end hardware asset lifecycle on ServiceNow HAM/HAM Pro-on Order, In Stock, In Use, In Maintenance, Retired, Disposed states-for end-user devices, data center equipment, network gear, and consumables.

Maintain alm_asset and alm_hardware records: asset tags, serial numbers, ownership, location, cost-centre, depreciation, and warranty/lease attributes.

Process and fulfil IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) tickets, hardware refresh/reclamation, transfer orders between stockrooms, and disposal orders with full audit-trail documentation.

Understand HAM / CMDB normalization concept-resolve unnormalized models, manufacturer aliases, and EOL/EOSL dates; drive normalization to ≥95% target.

Perform scheduled and ad-hoc inventory audits (including Mobile Agent/barcode scanning); reconcile physical vs. system records and remediate ghost/missing assets.

Track lease and warranty data, raise renewals 60-90 days in advance, and feed refresh planning into Procurement.

Maintain stockroom, bundle, consumable, and model-category data per defined policy.

CMDB

Maintain CI hygiene across CMDB CI classes within scope.

Apply and tune Identification & Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules-identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source precedence, and inclusion rules-for assigned CI classes; resolve duplicate-CI and overloaded-CI exceptions.

Drive and configure CMDB Health remediation against Completeness, Compliance, and Correctness KPIs in CMDB Workspace; clear orphan/stale/duplicate CI failures before the failure threshold is reached.

Configure and process CI attestation, Data Certification, and CMDB Workspace Data Manager retirement/delete policies for stale CIs.

Maintain CI relationships per the Common Service Data Model (CSDM 5.0)-Foundation, Ideation & Strategy, Design & Planning, Build & Integration, Service Delivery, Service Consumption, and Manage Portfolios domains.

Build and schedule operational reports and Performance Analytics widgets covering CMDB Health %, Hardware Normalization %, Asset Refresh due, Stockroom inventory, and Audit findings.

 Required Skills

 3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow/others administration with at least 2 years on HAM and/or CMDB.

Demonstrated working knowledge of HAM lifecycle states, asset/model/category data model, stockrooms, transfer orders, purchase orders, receiving slips, asset bundles, and disposal orders.

Working knowledge of CMDB tables, CI classes, and CSDM concepts.

Hands-on with IRE identification rules, reconciliation rules, and at least one duplicate-CI deduplication exercise.

Working knowledge of CMDB Health (Completeness, Compliance, Correctness) and dashboard remediation.

ITIL v4 process awareness-Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management, Service Request.

Import Sets/Transform Maps fundamentals; ability to read JavaScript/Glide script for basic edits.

Strong written and oral communication in English; ability to run client status calls.

Tools & Technologies

ServiceNow Modules

HAM, HAM Pro, ITAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM, Performance Analytics, Mobile Agent, CMDB Workspace, Hardware Asset Workspace, Now Assist for ITAM (awareness).

Summary

 Position Summary 

 ServiceNow CMDB - Senior Consultant 

 Enterprise Performance

 Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice helps organizations improve business outcomes through platform-enabled transformation, technology modernization, and operational improvement. Within this space, our teams work across IT operations, service management, workflow automation, and enterprise platforms to deliver large-scale digital transformation programs. As a ServiceNow Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, build, and enhance ServiceNow solutions that help clients streamline processes, improve service delivery, and create long-term business value.

 Level : Senior Consultant or equivalent

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

 Work you'll do

 As a Senior Consultant, Technical on the Enterprise Operations Portfolio team, you will be responsible for:

 Governance: Develop and enforce CMDB policies, procedures, and standards.

Define and maintain the CMDB scope, including identification and reconciliation of critical CIs.

Establish and monitor CMDB performance metrics to ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs)

Lead the discussions with stakeholders (internal and external)

Provide resolutions for conflicts/ challenges

 CMDB Design and Implementation: Collaborate with stakeholders to define CMDB requirements and design.

Configure and customize the CMDB tool to align with organizational needs.

Implement and maintain CI relationships, hierarchies, and attributes.

 CI Lifecycle Management: Establish and maintain a process for CI identification, reconciliation, classification, and labelling.

Coordinate and oversee the CI registration, verification, and documentation process.

Ensure accurate and timely updates to the CMDB for all CI changes, including additions, modifications, and retirements.

 Data Integrity and Quality:

 Develop and implement data quality controls to ensure CMDB accuracy and completeness.

Conduct regular audits to identify and resolve data inconsistencies or discrepancies.

Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and improve data accuracy.

 Change and Release Management Integration: Collaborate with Change and Release Management teams to ensure CMDB is updated with approved changes and releases.

Facilitate the impact analysis of proposed changes on CIs and related services.

Provide CMDB data for change impact assessments and change advisory board (CAB) meetings.

 Reporting and Analysis: Generate and distribute Custom CMDB reports and dashboards to stakeholders.

Analyse CMDB data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement.

Provide insights and recommendations for optimizing IT asset and configuration management processes.

 Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Shift Timings: 24x7 including night shift as per business requirements

 Qualifications

 Required :

 • 6-10 years of ServiceNow development experience in large enterprise environments
• Experience configuring and developing ServiceNow using UI Policies, UI Macros, UI Pages, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Business Rules, Access Control Lists (ACLs), Import Sets, Transform Maps, Update Sets, and MID Server configuration
• Experience with JavaScript, HyperText Markup Language (HTML), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Bootstrap, JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), Representational State Transfer (REST), and Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP)
• Experience delivering solutions across ServiceNow products such as IT Service Management (ITSM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Customer Service Management (CSM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD), or custom applications
• Experience with Asset Management, Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Orchestration, and ServiceWatch
• Experience working in Agile delivery and application development lifecycle phases
• Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university

 Preferred :

 • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD), ArchX, or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification
• Experience designing and implementing integrations with third-party systems
• Understanding of ServiceNow Agentic AI framework
• Experience integrating generative artificial intelligence models into ServiceNow workflows
• Exposure to ServiceNow Now Assist
• ITIL v3/v4 or Agile/Scrum certification
